ITA-5.76.60 vilaṃghitadurbalendriyālpāgnini विलंघितदुर्बलेन्द्रियाल्पाग् निनिरूढ-विरेचनव्यापत्
Condition caused by purgation therapy administered to person who is fasting

vilepī विलेपी
Thick rice gruel
A rice gruel preparation which contains a greater solid than liquid portion; it is prepared by adding 4 parts water to one part broken rice and boiling until the rice becomes soft.
